correctness.rationale: Operational-time representation makes T_n the inverse of the independent integrated clock evaluated at simple-walk hitting time H_n. The random-walk invariance principle gives H_n/n^2->Brownian H. The triangular array Laplace transform of integrated rates at n^(2alpha)t converges to exp(-ct s^alpha); joint convergence and a continuous comparison event identify c^(-1)(H/U_alpha)^alpha. Brownian sine spectral formula and stable Laplace transform yield the survival integral. Gamma integrations prove E H^(alpha q) and E U^(-alpha q); a free-walk survival heat-kernel bound plus Laplace split yield uniform v^(-1/(2alpha)) tails and moment convergence below threshold. Error-function limit and stable negative half-moment give the sharp tail constant. Independently checked gamma-product at alpha .3/.7, valid q; the finite checker alone is not proof.
